ko: 그는 보이지 않아도 날 위해 일하시네
en: God will make a way, when there seems to be no way. He works in ways we cannot see, He will make a way for me.

ko: 주 나의 인도자 항상 함께 하시네
en: He will be my guide, hold me closely to His side. With love and strength for each new day, He will make a way.
By a roadway in the wilderness, He'll lead me. Rivers in the desert will I see.

ko: 하늘과 땅 변해도 주의 말씀 영원히
내 삶 속에 새 일을 행하리
en: But His Word will still remain. He will do something new today.
